cards.title: Phewa Lake
cards.blurb: Nepal's second-largest lake, with Machhapuchhre reflected in still water at dawn. Painted wooden doongas ferry visitors across.

cards.title: Tal Barahi Temple
cards.blurb: A two-tiered pagoda on a small island in the middle of Phewa Lake, dedicated to the boar-headed goddess Barahi.

cards.title: Sunrise from Sarangkot
cards.blurb: From the ridge above the lake, the sun lights Dhaulagiri, Annapurna and Machhapuchhre one after another.

cards.title: Davis Falls
cards.blurb: Patale Chhango, where the Pardi Khola vanishes into an underground tunnel. Just across the road, Gupteshwor Mahadev Cave follows the water down.

cards.title: World Peace Stupa
cards.blurb: Shanti Stupa crowns the Anadu hill on the far shore of Phewa — the view back over the city and lake is worth the climb.

cards.title: Pashmina Shawl
cards.blurb: Soft cashmere woven from the undercoat of Himalayan mountain goats, bargained for in a Lakeside shop.

cards.title: Paragliding over the Lake
cards.blurb: Launch off Sarangkot and spiral down with the eagles. Roll for the thermals — a good one keeps you up for an hour.

cards.title: Boating on Phewa
cards.blurb: Row yourself out to Tal Barahi, or hire a boatman and arrive dry. Roll to see how straight you steer.

cards.title: Zipline Race
cards.blurb: One of the steepest ziplines in the world drops off Sarangkot. Everyone races — highest roll hits the bottom first.
